defs.def: a situation, an event, etc. that makes it difficult for you to do or achieve sth 障碍；阻碍；绊脚石

ex.s: She has overcome a number of obstacles in nursing her business to the success it is today.
ex.t: 她在将自己的事业培育成今天这样成功的过程中克服了许多障碍。

ex.s: The language barrier can be an obstacle to understanding.
ex.t: 语言障碍可能是理解的阻碍。

ex.s: I frankly call the teller of the truth an artist, since no one who is not in effect an artist can successfully overcome this obstacle in the path of the ultimate endeavor.
ex.t: 我坦白地称讲真话的人为艺术家，因为一个实际上不是艺术家的人是无法在终极努力的途中成功克服这一障碍的。

ex.s: No, there is no obstacle to the mind that cannot be improved by suitable studies, just like the disease of the body which can be treated by appropriate exercise.
ex.t: 不，没有什么是适当的学问不能改善的思想障碍，就像身体的疾病可以通过适当的锻炼来治疗一样。

defs.def: an object that is in your way and that makes it difficult for you to move forward 障碍物；绊脚石
a fence, etc. for a horse to jump over 障碍赛马
